recipes.name: The Easiest Nutella Brownies (3 Ingredients)
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together the Nutella and eggs. Stir in the flour and salt until fully combined.
Into an 8x8 non-stick baking dish, pour your batter and bake for 14-16 minutes until set or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let cool to room temp before cutting. Serve and enjoy.
